chunks: As for what was narrated by ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Bābawayh, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn al-Ṣalt, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Ṣalt, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿUbayd Allāh al-Ḥalabī, who said:

I asked him about a man and a woman over whom the salat is performed. He said: the man is placed in front of the woman, on the side toward the qiblah, so that the head of the woman is near the hip of the man on the side of his left; and her head also is on the side of the Imam’s left, while the head of the man is on the side of the Imam’s right.

key_terms.الْقِبْلَةَ: the direction toward which the bodies are oriented
key_terms.وَرِكِ الرَّجُلِ: the man’s hip, used here as a positional reference point
key_terms.يَسَارَ الْإِمَامِ: the left side of the Imam
key_terms.يَمِينَ الْإِمَامِ: the right side of the Imam
key_terms.يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِمَا: the funeral salat is performed over both of them

ai.seo_question: How should a man and a woman be positioned for funeral salat when their جنازات are prayed over together?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the arrangement of a male and female bier when the funeral salat is performed over them together. It gives the positional ruling for how their bodies are to be placed relative to one another, the qiblah, and the Imam.
